sources.source: Fire and rescue incident statistics, year ending March 2026
sources.authority: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_fact: The 22 July 2026 official release reports 641,227 incidents attended, including 170,597 fires and 254 fire-related fatalities. Collection moved from the Incident Recording System to the Fire and Rescue Data Platform in November 2025 and the live platform can be revised.
sources.quality_effect: Adds national fire-response context and a source-platform break guard; the figures are not parcel-level fire risk or local response-time measurements.

sources.source: Police workforce, England and Wales: 31 March 2026
sources.verified_fact: The 22 July 2026 official release reports 234,441 paid workforce FTE, including 145,886 police officers, and 20,989 officers and PCSOs in neighbourhood policing roles including relevant trainees.
sources.quality_effect: Adds force-capacity context while preventing workforce volume or neighbourhood staffing from being treated as recorded-crime incidence or parcel safety.

sources.source: Operation of police powers under TACT 2000, to March 2026
sources.verified_fact: The 23 July 2026 official release reports 3,061 terrorism-related arrests in the year ending March 2026, of which 2,819 were linked to supporting Palestine Action after its 5 July 2025 proscription; it also expands section 43 stop-and-search coverage beyond the Metropolitan Police for the first time.
sources.quality_effect: Adds a mandatory legal-event and coverage-change guard; the exceptional arrest series cannot be compared naively with earlier periods or used as local parcel risk.

sources.source: Police use of firearms statistics, April 2025 to March 2026
sources.verified_fact: The official release reports 17,584 police firearms operations in the year ending March 2026 and 6,558 authorised firearms officers at 31 March 2026, of whom 5,917 were operationally deployable.
sources.quality_effect: Adds armed-policing operational context but explicitly separates deployments and officer capacity from firearms-offence prevalence and parcel safety.

sources.source: Firearm and shotgun certificates, April 2025 to March 2026
sources.verified_fact: The 18 June 2026 official release reports 470,785 people holding a firearm certificate, shotgun certificate or both at 31 March 2026, 5% fewer than a year earlier and the lowest comparable total since 2016.
sources.quality_effect: Adds a lawful-certificate stock guard: certificate-holder counts are administrative stock data, not illegal firearms incidence, victimisation or parcel-level threat.

sources.source: Reported road casualties Great Britain, provisional results: 2025
sources.verified_fact: The provisional official estimates report 1,556 fatalities, 29,910 killed-or-seriously-injured casualties and 127,870 casualties of all severities in 2025. The figures are based on police data supplied by 11 May 2026 and remain subject to final validation.
sources.quality_effect: Adds road-safety context with an explicit provisional-data gate; national casualty totals are not local collision exposure or parcel-access safety measurements.

sources.source: Reported road casualties Great Britain: implemented and upcoming changes
sources.verified_fact: From May 2026, road-casualty statistics use current local-authority boundaries, emphasise severity-adjusted KSI figures and report casualty rates per billion miles; the final 2025 annual publication is scheduled for 30 July 2026.
sources.quality_effect: Adds boundary-version, severity-adjustment and denominator guards so future local comparisons do not mix incompatible geography or rate definitions.
